title: The Calculus of Distinction: Foundational Closure of the Mono-Process Framework
description: A comprehensive archival bundle containing the formal symbolic derivations and empirical validation results for the Four Master Theorems of the Mono-Process Framework. This collection proves the 3-Peak Rule of Identity, the Singularity Rebound Mechanism, the Necessity of Tertiary Node Structure, and the Topology-Geometry Biconditional.
